answer: Each agent bonds stake before an epoch and evaluates its identity polynomial, proving membership in a Semaphore-style tree. RLN proofs bind messages to a rate-limit nullifier; exceeding the quota with distinct messages exposes Shamir shares that reconstruct the agent’s private key, enabling verifiable, immediate collateral slashing. A garden-rooted registry, jade commitments, and forge-checked proofs make duplicate messaging costly rather than merely detectable.
